note: Maps each stage of an x402 transaction to the record fields this suite checks. Stage labels follow the Evidence Chain RFP (S2 offer to S7 fulfilment); x402 field names follow the v2 specification.

verdicts.accepted: verified: every join in the record recomputes
verdicts.fulfilment.evaluated false: not evaluated: visible in the record and does not block acceptance
verdicts.indeterminate: the evidence needed to establish the join is absent, and the reason names what is missing
verdicts.rejected: contradicted: the evidence present fails the join, and the reason names the clause
